rules: Game art only: every frame comes from the game's own art and UI or an approved scene; never supplied posters or new artwork.
Real UI only, full state; never ask for cropped or hidden UI; ask for a real state. Missing scene: keep the topic, put it in needs.
Never change a post's topic because a scene is missing.

Money: natural game economy UI may appear incidentally; economic values are never the subject (not in banner, captions, VO or post copy): USD, SOL or token price, floor, ROI, yield, pool values, reward amounts, investment framing.
No unverified Season 3 mechanics (rounds, fees, daily rotation, rewards, Titan count at launch); Titan names from the approved roll-call are fine.
No real player names, no 'beta', no mint/price promises.
Captions are concrete and editorial, never vague moods. Narration: short lines, dates in words, numbers never spoken.
First time right: lock the poster hero, the steps in order, verbatim narration lines, banners and the end CTA in the brief (CREATIVE_BRIEF_V2 First-time-right).
Narration: one steady pace, music bed under it, punchy lines with ellipses, no verb repeated across lines, last line = call to action.
Monsters means a monster fight on the map (monsters.fight); the World Bank is its own step.
